verdict.rationale: The docs show fiat↔stablecoin conversion, but mostly as a side effect of other features rather than a first-class conversion API. Examples are optional auto-liquidation on deposit addresses, auto-converting customer USDC to USD in a treasury, paying out USDC from a USD treasury, and onramp/offramp between fiat and crypto. Token-to-token conversion appears only through the Agentic Wallet trade skill on Base. Missing for 10: an explicit quote/convert API endpoint, stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion within the custodial payments product, documented conversion rates and fees, documented settlement times, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
